reproduce.behavior: Re-records a literal playback of the preserved test log; it does not rerun the release tests.
reproduce.workspacePathConstraint: The tape records to an absolute path under /Volumes/Code/MuleinLabs and must be adjusted if the workspace is relocated.

capturedAtBasis: MP4 filesystem modification time at capture completion

captureMethod.mode: normal-speed playback of a preserved experiment log

artifacts.kind: durable byte-for-byte copy of the original release-test log

targetedMelt.interpretation: A deterministic local test observation inside the saved run, not a timing contract.

additionalSourceLogReceipt.reason: The local-pass capture is deliberately bounded to the six freeze-mask tests; the episode presents identity round-trip evidence separately.

timingContext.interpretation: The capture replays one preserved release-test run. It performs no fresh test execution. The 1.092-second targeted-melt value is an observation from that saved run, not a deterministic performance contract.

claimBoundaries: This MP4 is archived receipt playback, not a fresh execution of the release tests.
The visible receipt establishes that six freeze-mask tests, including the deterministic targeted two-bit melt, passed with zero failures in the preserved run.
The targeted-melt test does not emit the searched elite, resynthesize it with Yosys, or exhaustively re-prove the searched result.

The durable combined log also contains identity round-trip and corruption-detection results, but those lines are intentionally not projected in this local-pass capture and are presented separately in the episode.
The 1.092-second elapsed value is a local observation, not a timing contract or benchmark distribution.
This receipt does not establish topology mutation, area reduction, depth reduction, or general logic simplification.
Typed command echoes visibly wrap or overlap at some prompt boundaries in the VHS recording; the result lines remain legible and the durable source log is hash-identified.
